question: Which of these were among the allied forces the East India Company defeated at Buxar in 1764?

options.text: Mir Qasim, Shuja-ud-Daula and Shah Alam II
Siraj ud-Daulah, Mir Jafar and Robert Clive
Murshid Quli Khan, Alivardi Khan and Mir Jafar

explanation: In October 1764 Company forces defeated an allied army that included Mir Qasim, Shuja-ud-Daula and Shah Alam II.
